Build.description: The artifact one build of an `App` published, as the build lane writes it back (AP-13a).

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

BundleOrigin.description: A published bundle URL as a sync origin (MF-17).

secretRef.description: Credential for a protected bundle URL (MF-31).

url.description: URL of the bundle archive or `kind: Bundle` index; `https://` only.

ConflictPolicy.description: What an import does when a resource already exists (MF-23).

oneOf.description: Import the remote resource under a new name.

GitOrigin.description: A remote Git repository as a sync origin.

path.description: Subtree to sync; the whole repository when absent.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to follow.

secretRef.description: Read-only credential, resolved by the reconciler (MF-31).

url.description: Clone URL; `https://` or an `ssh://`/`git@` remote, never plain `http://`.

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource is live and active in cluster.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

PlatformApiOrigin.description: Another platform instance's public resource API as a sync origin (MF-32).

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the remote instance, `https://` only.

project.description: Project slug to follow on the remote instance.

secretRef.description: Credential for the remote resource API (MF-31).

Schedule.description:
How often a [`SyncSourceSpec`] runs (MF-28): `{ interval: 30m }` or `{ webhook: true }`.

Exactly one of the two members is set, for the same reason as [`SyncOrigin`].

webhook.description: Driven by a webhook from the source instead of a timer; only `true` is a schedule.

SecretRef.description:
Reference to a credential stored in SOPS or OpenBao (PF-36).

`deny_unknown_fields` is a security control: it rejects inline `value:` or `password:` fields at parse time, enforcing that secrets never appear in Git or manifest files.

envVar.description: Optional environment variable name for injection into runners.

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

build.description: What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named (AP-13a). Written back by the build lane in the commit that publishes the artifact; an App without it renders no pod, and no other principal may set it (AP-73).

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

SyncMode.description: What a sync run does with the synced subtree.

oneOf.description: The source keeps winning; local edits show up as drift.

SyncOrigin.description:
What a [`SyncSourceSpec`] follows (MF-27).

Exactly one of the three members is set. This is the shape the docs print (`source: { git: { … } }`) and, unlike an externally tagged Rust enum, it survives the YAML round-trip without a `!Git` tag.

git.description: A remote Git repository, optionally a subtree of it.

autoMerge.description: Whether a clean sync merge request merges itself (CC-70, MF-29).

conflictPolicy.description: What to do when a resource already exists locally (MF-23).

mode.description: Mirror the source continuously or copy it once.

prune.description: Whether resources missing from the source are deleted; deletions are never implied (CC-19).

selector.description: Label selector narrowing which resources of the source are synced (MF-10).

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

apiVersion.description: API version: [`API_VERSION`], or a version [`serves`] accepts for this kind.

metadata.description: Metadata identifying and labeling the resource.

status.description: Server-computed status. Stripped during export and serialization.
